The '''Tinuvia system''' was located in the [[Tragan Cluster/Legends|Tragan Cluster]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the formation known as the [[Tinuvian tar pit]].<ref name="VectorPrime">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Tinuvian tar pit]]|system=Tinuvia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tinuvia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-5.<ref name="TEA" />
